about: The configuration of the publishing tool in the content store (configuration.json, GATE-04, R103). Both implementations read every case: `text` is the text of the file (null: the store has no file), `denyList` and `noindexFolders` are what a valid text gives, and `error` is the message that both give for a text that they refuse.

cases.name: a deny list and noindex folders
an empty list of noindex folders
noindex folders that are not a list
cases.error: configuration.json: the noindex folders must be a list of folders

cases.name: noindex folders as null
cases.error: configuration.json: the noindex folders must be a list of folders

cases.name: a noindex folder that is not a text
cases.error: configuration.json: the noindex folders must be a list of folders

cases.name: a noindex folder that leaves the vault
cases.error: configuration.json: the noindex folders entry "../Seed Bank" is not a vault path. Write a folder as "Folder/Sub folder"

cases.name: a noindex folder with a slash at its end
cases.error: configuration.json: the noindex folders entry "Seed Bank/" is not a vault path. Write a folder as "Folder/Sub folder"
